workflows.title: Data ownership and visibility handoff
workflows.decision: Review payload/control visibility, ownership reuse and scoped ordering-outcome evidence.
intent_questions: Which physical payload/control objects and ownership lifecycle must this producer-to-consumer handoff preserve?
Which actual coherence path, maintenance target/completion, ordering and consumer reads establish visibility before reclaim and reuse?

evidence_roles.meaning: Original independently required behavior, objective or acceptance contract
Actual selected revision, configuration, mode and native tool/model basis
Original native observations and outcomes for the selected engineering question
Source-backed logical-to-native entity and population relationships

revalidate_when: Original requirement, applicability, exclusion rationale or receiving decision changes
Selected native entity, source, configuration, mode, tool/model version or extraction method changes
A dependent relationship or observation premise is changed, missing or contradicted

workflows.title: Memory ordering and atomicity boundary
workflows.decision: Review memory ordering and atomicity boundary through existing correction, handoff and revalidation.
intent_questions: What exact visibility or atomicity claim is required across which memory or I/O domains?
Which selected native model, barrier placement and allowed/observed outcomes support that claim at its original strength?
